briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push multi-agent frontiers as compute bottlenecks intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race accelerates with frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models while regulatory scrutiny grows. Funding remains robust but compute constraints are emerging as the primary limiter. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction in security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o4 achieves new SOTA on agentic tasks; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus shows gains in safety benchmarks; Meta open-sources Llama 4 400B; DeepSeek-V3.5 matches closed models on coding. xAI deploys Grok-3 cluster. Google integrates Gemini 3 into search at scale.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. NIST releases updated AI RMF 2.0 draft. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips; Microsoft announces $15B Stargate expansion in Texas; NVIDIA Blackwell shipments hit 500k units. Energy deals signed for dedicated AI data centers in UAE and Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems by end of 2027?
